cases.disposition_reason: Generated Run suite (functional) in .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/suites.yml is mbx nextest run --workspace --no-tests fail --profile functional. --profile functional selects .config/nextest.toml profile.functional default-filter binary(functional). --no-tests fail is present. partitions = 1 stays explicit in .velnor/config.toml, so velnor-actions 0.1.73 emits one unsharded job and does not add --partition. required = true only adds suite-functional to the generated required verdict needs and VELNOR_NEEDS_EXPECTED; it does not call the GitHub branch-protection API. Artifact functional-terminal-evidence when is always (if: always()), paths target/functional and target/nextest/functional, retention 14 days. Blockers: no --locked argv, because RustSuiteConfig has no suite argv field and mbx 1.29.1 run_cargo does not inject --locked (mbx nextest run --help lists it as optional); no inventory-script step, because velnor-actions cannot emit scripts/check-refactor-coverage.py, and that script must not be a required check yet (2223 inventory rows are BLOCKED and the script exits 1; missing committed baselines already fail functional tests through Tuiscotti FrozenStore); branch protection unverified (HTTP 404 {"message":"Branch not protected","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/rest/branches/branch-protection#get-branch-protection","status":"404"} on test/pre-refactor-protection and design/interaction-polish; rulesets []); macOS and Windows unclaimed (one runner_label ubuntu-26.04, no OS matrix); schedule left empty because a cron would attach to the existing suites workflow rather than an additional workflow, and the required gate is already on pull_request and push.
cases.entry_path: pull_request and push run job suite-functional; workflow_dispatch tier functional runs the same command on suites.yml
cases.return_path: the required verdict job needs suite-functional; the functional profile command is unchanged
